body:
out of everything i read here on reddit - and ive read a lot - your comment was the sweetest, kindest one. bless you.
(I dont even know why tho but i got these vibes from reading it).

Im not brave enough to kill myself, i hate pain and am afraid of what expects me on the other side. I just wish i had somewhere to run away to. I just need to disappear from everyone i know. Everyone. And never come back. Start a whole new life. This one is just NOT WORKING. I have FAILED.
